messages.content: 如何設計一個大教堂風格的天花板？

function.name: building_information_get_data

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "如何設計一個大教堂風格的天花板？" They want design guidance for a cathedral-style ceiling. We can provide architectural design tips: vaulted ceilings, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses, stained glass, frescoes, etc. Provide steps: conceptualization, structural analysis, material selection, decorative elements, lighting, acoustics. Also mention typical features: high vaulted ceilings, ribbed vaults, pointed arches, buttresses, stained glass windows, frescoes, ornamental plasterwork, etc. Provide a design process: research, sketches, 3D modeling, structural calculations, material procurement, construction sequencing, finishing touches. Also mention safety, building codes, acoustics, lighting, maintenance. Provide references to famous cathedrals: Notre-Dame, Cologne Cathedral, Chartres. Provide suggestions for modern adaptation: use steel or timber framing, incorporate LED lighting, acoustic panels, etc. Provide a step-by-step guide. Also mention potential challenges: load-bearing, acoustics, moisture control, ventilation. Provide a sample design concept: a high vaulted ceiling with ribbed vaults, central nave, transept, choir, stained glass windows, frescoed dome, etc. Provide a list of materials: stone, concrete, steel, timber, plaster, glass, pigments. Provide a timeline. Provide a cost estimate. Provide a checklist. Provide references. Provide a summary. Also mention that the user might want to know how to design such a ceiling. So we should give a thorough answer.
